messages:
camille: Heads-up — customer reported what looks like double-billing when tool-call retries happen during a burst window. Example log: `req=abc123 prompt=45 completion=120 retry=1 charged=165` but they say actual tokens should be 165 total not 285. Anyone seen this pattern?

jon: Seen it in the 03:10 UTC spike. Our metering path appears to emit a completion event on the initial attempt and then emit another completion when the retry finishes; no dedupe on tool-call subrequests.

maria: We dedupe at the top-level request_id for prompt tokens, but tool calls create child request ids (`tool:xyz:attempt:1`) so they bypass dedupe. We did that to preserve observability of individual tool timings.

ash: Product question: should quota semantics be per-key or per-org for bursts? If per-key, a retry from the same API key should definitely dedupe. If per-org, two different keys acting on same org could still exhaust quota.

billing-bot: ALERT: billing-spike detected for org=acme-corp delta=+18% window=2026-11-03T03:12Z — top contributor: tool_calls

camille: Proposed quick fix: attach `parent_request_id` and `tool_call_hash` to every metering event and run dedupe on the tuple (parent_request_id, tool_call_hash). TTL = 2m to cover common retry windows. This keeps tool-level observability but avoids double charge.

jon: Sketch of a prototype config:

```
metering.dedupe.enabled = true
metering.dedupe.store = redis://meter-dedupe.internal:6379
metering.dedupe.ttl = 120s
metering.key = sha256(parent_request_id + ":" + tool_call_hash)
```

maria: Caveat: streaming completions. We sometimes send partial stream frames and then restart the completion path on retry; we currently increment token counts per-chunk. If we dedupe only by tool_call_hash we need a way to mark 'finalized' frames so we don't undercount. Suggest adding `final=true` flag on final chunk events and only count tokens on final unless the request times out.

ash: That might undercount in cases where final never arrives. Maybe: count provisional tokens, but if a later final event with same dedupe key arrives, reconcile (credit provisional). Reconciliation can be expensive though.

jon: Agreed. Simpler flow for now: 1) prompt tokens counted immediately (dedupe by parent_request_id), 2) tool-call tokens buffered and emitted only on `final` OR upon TTL expiry; 3) dedupe key prevents double final emissions. This avoids immediate double-charge while keeping bounded delay.

camille: Also consider per-key vs per-org rules: for Hosted customers we'll enable global dedupe (cross-node); for Dedicated we keep config-pref so infra teams can opt-out if they want exact visibility. We'll need a migration and a clear rollback.

ops-bot: deploy-notice: metering-service v2.14 candidate will be deployed to staging in 30m, window=10m

maria: I can add telemetry fields in Console: `metering_event.parent_request_id`, `metering_event.tool_call_id`, `metering_event.retry_index`, `metering_event.tokens`, `metering_event.final` — and panels: dedupe_hits, dedupe_misses, double_billed_cases. Will aim to have staging panels by EOD.

jon: Implementation blockers: cross-region dedupe store. Redis with primary-replica may be fine but race conditions on eventual consistency. Need to ensure atomic SETNX semantics. Also evictions could lead to misses — TTL choices matter.

camille: Security note — do not store raw customer ids in dedupe keys. Use hashed ids (HMAC with platform secret). Add that to RFC.

ash: Support flow: we should refund obvious duplicates automatically if dedupe shows same key billed twice within 2m window. Maria, can you surface a 'likely-duplicate' filter for finance?

maria: Yep — I'll add a filter query and a view in the Billing console. Also create alert if dedupe_hit_rate < 99% after rollout.

jon: Action items: (1) I'll spin up Redis prototype and basic dedupe middleware (2) Maria will add telemetry + dashboard (3) Camille will draft RFC for per-key/per-org semantics + rollout plan (4) Ash to coordinate support/refund policy.

camille: Plan also includes feature-flagged rollout, tests for streaming corner cases, and a small backfill job to detect historical duplicates for refunding (no auto backfill initially).

ash: Sounds good. If anyone hits blocker ping me directly. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: NOTE: please include billing-team in RFC reviewers — billing@redwood-inference.internal

camille: Thanks all — will post RFC link shortly.
